Question Choices: Reduce 154/182 to lowest terms using prime factorization.
Solution: 154 = 2 × 7 × 11 and 182 = 2 × 7 × 13, so the GCD is 2 × 7 = 14 and the fraction reduces to 11/13.

Question Choices: Reduce 135/105 to lowest terms using prime factorization.
Solution: The GCD is 3 × 5 = 15. 135 ÷ 15 = 9 and 105 ÷ 15 = 7, so the fraction is 9/7.
